description:
We listened. We are ditching the AI Voiceover and going back to a human narrator just like in this video. Let us know how you like it in the comments!

Please follow us on X (Twitter): https://x.com/policeinsidertv

A 19-year-old led officers on a high-speed chase through three cities in a stolen car, then turned around and came back. One innocent person would not survive that decision. 

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.

All suspects are innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

event_summary.short: A high-speed chase initiated by two teen carjackers ended in a crash that killed an 85-year-old woman. The driver was convicted of involuntary manslaughter, aggravated robbery, and other charges; the passenger was convicted of aggravated robbery and attempted murder.
